welcome.parentCtaSub: Scan the code or open the link

consent.title: Before we start
consent.body: Your family will see your checks and alerts, so they can protect you.
consent.detail: They don't see your messages, photos or conversations. They only see what you checked, the answer you got and when you asked for help.
consent.whoProtectsMeBody: These people see your checks and alerts:

setup.footer: ΑΛΤ! will never ask for codes, cards or your bank PIN.

language.title: Language and text size
language.preview: This is how the text will look.

calls.title: Call protection
calls.intro: ΑΛΤ! will warn you about suspicious calls. It never listens to or records your conversations.
calls.roleWhy: So it can see who is calling before you answer.
calls.notificationsWhy: So it can show you the warning.
calls.phoneStateWhy: So it can ask how it went when you hang up.
calls.overlayWhy: So you see the warning on top of the call screen.
calls.fullScreenWhy: So the question appears straight away, even when the phone is locked.
calls.batteryWhy: So the phone doesn't close it to save battery.
calls.iosBody: On iPhone, ΑΛΤ! labels numbers reported as scams. Go to Settings > Apps > Phone > Call Blocking & Identification and turn on ΑΛΤ!.
calls.iosManual: After any strange call, tap "Someone just called me" on the home screen.
calls.notSupported: This phone is too old for call checking. After any strange call, tap "Someone just called me".

family.title: Family phone numbers
family.body: Calls from these numbers won't show a warning.
family.empty: You haven't added any numbers yet.
family.contactsPermission: ΑΛΤ! only reads the contacts you choose.
family.ownPhoneHint: So your family can call you straight away when you ask for help.

safeWord.title: Our word
safeWord.body: Choose a secret word together. If someone says they're family and asks for money, ask them for the word.
safeWord.guidance: Something odd but easy, that isn't on Facebook.
safeWord.saved: Only we remember it. We don't send it anywhere.
safeWord.hint: Don't write it on a note next to the phone.

test.title: Test call
test.instructions: Call this phone from a number that is NOT in the family. You'll see the warning together.
test.seen: ΑΛΤ! saw the call! Did you see the warning?
test.iosBody: A test call isn't possible on iPhone. Try the "Someone just called me" button together.

setup.finishBody: ΑΛΤ! is ready to look out for you.

home.askingMoney: Someone is asking me for money
home.safeWordBody: If someone says they're family and asks for money, ask them for the word.

pin.title: Enter your PIN
pin.setTitle: Would you like a PIN for the app?
pin.lockedOut: Too many wrong tries. Try again in a minute.
pin.forgot: Forgot your PIN? Ask your family to reinstall ΑΛΤ! and send you a new invitation.

home.noParents: You haven't connected a parent yet.
home.startSetup: Do the setup on their phone
home.startSetupBody: Take your parent's phone. You set it up together and it takes about 5 minutes.

history.empty: Nothing here yet. Checks and alerts will show up here.

settings.safeWordReauth: For safety, sign in again before you change the word.
settings.safeWordHashedNote: We can't show you the word, because we don't keep it anywhere. You can change it, though.
settings.subscriptionWeb: Subscriptions are handled on the ΑΛΤ! website, in your account.
settings.wordChanged: The word has changed. Tell your parent the new word too.

analysis.fallbackScamReason: It has signs that scams often have.
analysis.fallbackScamAction: Don't pay and don't reply. Ask your family.
analysis.fallbackCautionAction: Don't do anything yet. Ask your family.
analysis.safeReasonNeutral: I don't see a request for money or codes.
analysis.safeAction: If they ask you for a payment or a code later, send it to me again.

check.tooMany: You've made a lot of checks. Try again in a little while or ask your family.
check.tooLong: The text is too long. Send only the message that worries you.

voice.notAvailable: Speech recognition isn't available. We'll send the recording to be checked.

verdict.safeHint: If they ask you for a payment or a code later, send it to me again.

channels.alertHint: If they are pressuring you right now, open ΑΛΤ! and tap "Someone is asking me for money".
channels.welcome: Hello! I'm ΑΛΤ!. So I know who you are, open the ΑΛΤ! app, tap "Connect Viber/WhatsApp" and send me the code you see (e.g. ALT-123456).
channels.linked: Done! From now on you can forward me anything that worries you and I'll tell you what to do.
channels.codeInvalid: That code isn't valid. Get a new one from the ΑΛΤ! app.
channels.unsupported: I can check text, photos and voice messages. Send me one of those.
channels.error: I couldn't check it right now. Don't do anything yet and ask your family.

callShield.checkinBody: Did they ask for money or codes, or say someone in your family is in trouble?

email.footer: ΑΛΤ! will never ask you for codes, cards or PINs.

email.giftHow: To redeem it: ΑΛΤ! app or alt.gr → Settings → Subscription → "I have a gift code".
email.paymentFailedSubject: Your ΑΛΤ! payment didn't go through
email.paymentFailedBody: We couldn't charge your card. Protection continues as normal for {days} days. Update your card so you don't lose the plan's extras.
email.paymentFailedNote: Family alerts and call warnings never stop, even if the subscription ends.

email.unsubscribe: Don't want this email? Change it in Settings.

quiz.pushBody: A little memory game for the family.
quiz.nudgeBody: They didn't remember it the last two times. Say it together, no pressure.
quiz.title: What's our word?
quiz.body: Type or say the family word.
quiz.correctBody: If someone says they're family and asks for money, ask them for this word.
quiz.wrongBody: Ask your family to tell you again. Try again whenever you like.

hero.headline: One day, your mum will get that phone call.
hero.subline: ΑΛΤ! warns her about suspicious calls, checks the messages she receives and alerts you straight away when someone asks her for money. No devices. Five-minute setup.
hero.phoneAlt: Mum's phone showing a warning about an unknown number during a call

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Download ΑΛΤ!, scan a code from your own phone and do the setup together in five minutes.
how.step2Body: A secret family word. If someone claims to be family and asks for money, she asks them for it.
how.step3Body: One big button, "Someone is asking me for money", alerts the whole family at once.

features.title: What ΑΛΤ! does
features.callBody: A warning about unknown and suspicious numbers before she answers, and one question after the call: "Did they ask for money?"
features.officialBody: They said they were the police or the bank? ΑΛΤ! checks whether the number really belongs to them.
features.messageBody: SMS, photo or voice note. An answer in seconds: 🟢 probably fine, 🟡 be careful, 🔴 likely a scam.
features.alertBody: Every guardian is alerted together. If nobody sees it within 5 minutes, an SMS goes out too.

radar.title: Scam Radar
radar.intro: The scams going around Greece right now, explained simply. Send them to your parents.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Start for free. Family alerts and call warnings are included in every plan.
pricing.freeFeatures: 1 parent, 2 guardians|Call warnings|Family alert|{checks} AI message checks a month|Your word and quizzes
pricing.familyFeatures: 2 parents, 4 guardians|Unlimited message checks|SMS if nobody sees an alert in 5 minutes|Silence and block suspicious calls|Weekly update on new scams
pricing.familyPlusFeatures: Up to 4 parents (in-laws too!)|Everything in Family
pricing.giftBody: A gift for Christmas, a name day or Mother's Day: 3, 6 or 12 months of Family.

gift.title: Give safety
gift.intro: Buy a gift code and give it to a friend or relative for their parents.
gift.emailLabel: Your email (we'll send you the code)
gift.thanksBody: We've emailed you the gift code. If you don't see it in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

org.sheetTitle: ΑΛΤ! for older people in our area
org.sheetIntro: ΑΛΤ! protects against phone and message scams. It's offered free for one year by {org}.
org.sheetStep1: On the phone of the child, relative or social worker: download the ΑΛΤ! app and tap "I want to protect my parent".
org.sheetStep2: Create the family and connect the older person's phone by scanning the QR code that appears.
org.sheetStep3: In Settings → Subscription → "I have a gift or municipality code", type the code below.
org.sheetStep4: Do the setup together on the older person's phone. It takes about 5 minutes.
org.sheetValid: Valid until {date}. One code per family.
org.landingCode: Have a code from your municipality? Enter it in the app under Settings → Subscription.
org.suppressedNote: To protect families, activity numbers are hidden (—) in weeks with fewer than {min} people taking part.

account.deleteBody: Your account will be deleted. If you are a family's only guardian, the whole family and its history will be deleted and the subscription cancelled. This can't be undone.
account.exportBody: Everything we hold about you, as a JSON file.
account.leaveBody: Your family will no longer see your checks and alerts, and ΑΛΤ! will stop protecting you. Your history will be deleted.
account.lastGuardian: You are the last guardian. Add another guardian before you leave.
account.removeMemberBody: Use this if they changed phones: remove the old one and send a new invitation.
account.analyticsSub: They help us improve the app. Never messages, names or numbers.
